computed_scope: finite n<=2 real scalar basis transform and one selected exact scalar product plus hard-projection bookkeeping only

declared_conventions.complex_basis: Q^(n)_(mL,mR)=sqrt((n+1)/(2*pi^2)) D^(n/2)_(mL,mR), with doubled labels 2*mL,2*mR in {-n,-n+2,...,n}
declared_conventions.conjugation: conj(Q^(n)_(mL,mR))=(-1)^((mL-mR)/2) Q^(n)_(-mL,-mR), where mL and mR are doubled labels and the exponent is integral
declared_conventions.geometry: unit round S3 identified with SU(2), Haar volume Vol(S3)=2*pi^2
declared_conventions.ordering: degrees n=0,1,2; within each degree, conjugation orbits are ordered by their lexicographically least doubled-label mode, with a self orbit retained at its lexicographic position and each nonself pair emitting cos then sin
declared_conventions.product: the pinned two-Clebsch--Gordan complex product is expanded first, then converted with Q_a=sum_r conj(U_ra) R_r for R_r=sum_a U_ra Q_a
declared_conventions.projection: P_L retains real scalar degrees n<=L only after a full product. A removed component is a finite algebraic projection remainder, not a constraint residual or anomaly.
declared_conventions.real_transform: For each lexicographically first nonself conjugate pair a=(-mL,-mR) <= b=(mL,mR), with s=(-1)^((a_mL-a_mR)/2), R_a_cos=(Q_a+s Q_b)/sqrt(2) and R_a_sin=-I*(Q_a-s Q_b)/sqrt(2). Self-conjugate Q_(0,0) is retained as R.

exact_checks.statement: The finite real and complex basis lists have the same declared n<=2 cardinality.
The declared finite complex-to-real transform is unitary with respect to the pinned complex-basis inner product.
Every declared R row is fixed by the pinned Wigner-D conjugation operation.
Complex coordinate unit vectors survive complex-to-real-to-complex conversion exactly.
The selected real-basis product equals the preregistered exact transformed Gaunt coefficient packet.
Every coefficient in the selected product is real in the declared real basis.
The transformed real product reconstructs the full complex Wigner-D product exactly.
All recorded omitted real components are outside the declared hard degree cutoff.
The full real product is exactly the retained projected product plus its separately recorded discarded components.

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: This produces a finite scalar convention bridge, not a complete real scalar basis or any vector/TT or derivative coupling ledger.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: The pinned Wigner-D convention, conjugation rule, degree bound n<=2, and explicit lexicographic pairing are fixed.

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: The calculation checks finite linear algebra and selected scalar products only; it is not an ADM, HDA, Jacobi, BFV, or quantum statement.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: The complex Q modes are orthonormal and the displayed rows use the stated conjugation-pair combinations.
theorem_guards.theorem: Unitary complex-to-real change of finite orthonormal basis

theorem_guards.conclusion_and_scope: Any observed omission is a finite projection remainder, not a DD/DH/HH residual or a quantum anomaly.
theorem_guards.hypotheses: P_L is imposed only after the full selected product, and its omitted real modes are retained in the output record.
